script_text: Taurus, this week pulls the curtain back on what you really owe—and who you really want. Monday and Tuesday bring the Sun conjunct Mercury in Sagittarius in your 8th House, exposing shared money, debts, and intimate truths. Venus in Scorpio in your 7th House squares Pluto in your 10th House, so love and career may clash. Wednesday is your power day because Mercury trines Saturn in Aries in your 12th House, turning intuition into structure. That is the turning point: you choose discipline over drama. Late week, Uranus in Gemini in your 2nd House trines Pluto in Aquarius in your 10th House, bringing a bold money move or recognition, while the weekend favors rest over promises. Tuesday is your worst day because Venus squares Pluto, exposing control struggles. As an Earth sign ruled by Venus, ground every impulse in a real number. Follow for daily updates.
